name: JobPushToPool
description: push a job to a pool queue; typically followed by an unconditional wake-one

name: JobWakeOneInPool
description: wake one sleeping worker in a pool (43 call sites)

name: JobWakeOneExcept
description: wake one worker other than the caller

name: ResourceLoadManagerJob
description: persistent ResourceLoad manager job; idle loop via 1FEE28 = Sleep(1) poll at ~1 kHz

name: ResourceLoadIdlePoll
description: Sleep(1) poll loop of the ResourceLoad manager; wakes a worker per ms while loads are in flight

name: SignalUntilAcknowledged
description: SetEvent once per spin until the target thread wakes; called each frame from MeshletRequestLoadStep 5DC18

name: TaskGraphJobCreate
description: task-graph job creator; unconditional wake at 40D2F

name: EffectDispKick
description: kicks every EffectDisp worker each tick (call at 3D6F46), even with an empty list

name: EffectDispJoin
description: joins every EffectDisp worker each tick (call at 3D6F8B)

name: PopPathSetEvent
description: real SetEvent of the pop-path wake chain (after the WK gate at 40A4C)
